ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 5-10% coverage of high-intensity (white/off-white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-gray to black field across both lobes; distinct white ring-shaped and circular blobs (diameters 5-25 pixels) distributed bilaterally, with higher concentration in the medial-to-distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; calculated interior angle approximately 45 degrees; vertical depth from lobe peak to notch vertex is significant.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge of both lobes; frequency of peaks increases towards distal tips; pixel amplitude of serrations varies between 3-12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Curvature displays a slight convexity near the peduncle, transitioning into a concave sweep towards the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 50+ white, ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (5-15 pixel radius) concentrated on the central and outer lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (off-white) visible primarily on the interior surface of the right lobe (viewer perspective).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular rosette scarring patterns across entire visible ventral surface; presence of irregular, high-relief tan/brown pixel clusters on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly textured brown/tan clusters at the outer tips representing significant epibiotic colonization (barnacles) creating a jagged terminal profile.
